instagram.caption:
The pipe you cannot see.
The Under-Sink Cabinet in the Primary Bathroom. To store cleaning supplies and backstock around the plumbing without ever hiding a leak.

What done looks like:
1. Two pull-out bins clear of the P-trap
2. A pale tray on the cabinet floor with nothing stacked on it
3. One open bottle per job
4. Both shut-off valves in plain sight when the doors swing open
